title: Persist order status and audit log on shipping
description: When an order is shipped we now persist the new status and append an entry to the audit log. Adds the event helpers the shipping job calls.

expected.note: `recordEvent` returns a promise (it is declared `async` in ./events) but the call is not awaited, so `shipOrder` resolves before the audit write finishes and any rejection becomes an unhandled promise rejection. Await it (or return it) and handle failures.
`fetch` does not reject on HTTP error statuses, so a 4xx/5xx response is passed straight to `response.json()` and treated as success. Check `response.ok` and throw before parsing.
